name: DataLabels
description: A collection of all the DataLabel objects for the specified series.
remarks: Each DataLabel object represents a data label for a point or trendline. For a series without definable points (such as an area series), the DataLabels collection contains a single data label.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)
 If .HasChart Then
 With Chart.SeriesCollection(1)
 .HasDataLabels = True
 .DataLabels.NumberFormat = "##.##"
 End With
 End If
End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the horizontal alignment for the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the text orientation. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the object has a shadow. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the vertical alignment of the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlReadingOrder constant that represents the reading order for the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: AutoText
properties.description: True if all objects in the collection automatically generate appropriate text based on context. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the format code for the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: NumberFormatLinked
properties.description: True if the number format is linked to the cells (so that the number format changes in the labels when it changes in the cells). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ShowLegendKey
properties.description: True if the data label legend key is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the data labels. Read/write XlDataLabelPosition.

properties.name: ShowSeriesName
properties.description: True to show the series name for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the name. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowCategoryName
properties.description: True to display the category name for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the name. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowValue
properties.description: True to display the data label values for a specified chart. False to hide the values. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowPercentage
properties.description: True to display the percentage value for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the value. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowBubbleSize
properties.description: True to show the bubble size for the data labels on a chart. False to hide the bubble size. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Separator
properties.description: Sets or returns the separator for the data labels on a chart. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ShowRange
properties.description: Set to True to display the Value From Cells range field in all the chart data labels for a specified chart. Set to False to hide that field. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number for the object.

methods.name: Propagate
methods.description: Propagates the contents and formatting of the specified data label to all the other data labels in the series.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number in the DataLabels collection of the data label to propagate.
